claims: The native static pose constructor copies source joint raw Euler+0x2c into each local pose, builds packed basis columns by the formula Rz*Ry*Rx, and its update composes global basis ParentR*LocalR and global translation ParentR*LocalT+ParentT. GLB column-vector quaternion equivalents are localq=qz*qy*qx and globalq=parentq*localq; exact native polynomial/float rounding is outside this orientation-order claim.

The independently executed current stock-record audit covers94vehicles and2194rendered-or-omitted records, finds exactly5previously omitted multi-axis records and exactly2records with rotated ancestors (the two Corvette hoods). All scalar source-basis controls match Rz*Ry*Rx within1e-12. Source-global versus composed translation discrepancies are at most1.1920928955078125e-7. This does not yet verify a changed converter or browser rendering.
